rationale: This is a measurement-only story. Its required real-user-database browser run already has an executable harness, and the story explicitly requires no new implementation tests or broad regression suite. Prepared QA test files are therefore unnecessary; the existing end-to-end check and its acceptance assertions are specified below.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC1: Identify the measured revision and relevant product changes; build and serve the production frontend; record reproducible environment, settings, data counts, and cache context without sensitive contents.
acceptance_checks.expected: The Result identifies the backend/frontend revision and relevant dirty changes, production bundle and serving method, hardware/runtime/browser/database context, effective settings, relevant counts, and cache states. No credentials or private account contents are recorded.
acceptance_checks.verification: Review the three harness phase reports and the recorded build/run context; compare the reported revision and working tree state with the measured run.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC2: Measure default All scope on the real user PostgreSQL database across all three cache states, including first and repeat openings and the complete requested result set.
acceptance_checks.expected: All three phases are measured: cold-browser-cold-app, cold-browser-warm-app, and warm-browser-warm-app. Each phase includes first and repeat openings and a complete-set opening; synthetic data or filtered first-row timing is not used as a substitute.
acceptance_checks.verification: Run `npm run perf:profit-page cold-browser-cold-app`, `npm run perf:profit-page cold-browser-warm-app`, and `npm run perf:profit-page warm-browser-warm-app` from `frontend/`, using the real configured database and the harness's isolated disposable browser/cache setup.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC3: Time navigation through usable rendered completion, including calculation, persistence, transport, and rendering; verify quiescence, readable displayed values, and complete row count.
acceptance_checks.expected: Each reported completion is based on quiescence that includes row identity, excludes the settling window, demonstrates a real displayed-value read, and reports displayed rows equal to the complete requested result count for complete-set openings.
acceptance_checks.verification: Inspect harness output and implementation assertions in `frontend/scripts/profit-page-perf.mjs`; record complete-set displayed/requested counts, completion timing, and any failed completion/readability checks.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC4: Record individual times, per-state and overall maxima, stage attribution, and explicit 7000 ms compliance assessment.
acceptance_checks.expected: The Result lists individual elapsed times, each cache-state maximum, the overall maximum, and major-stage attribution. It explicitly states whether every measured opening is at most 7000 ms. A breach or unavailable environment is recorded as such.
acceptance_checks.verification: Reconcile the three phase reports, compute maxima from the reported individual openings, and compare each opening with the 7000 ms threshold.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC5: Establish fresh account data for the measured case and report any observed automatic refresh or wait.
acceptance_checks.expected: The Result records the supported configuration/workflow and evidence used to establish account freshness, and reports any automatic refresh or refresh wait observed. It makes no claim about the unresolved stale-account case.
acceptance_checks.verification: Review the recorded freshness evidence and observed request/refresh timeline. Include any refresh wait in end-to-end timing; do not infer freshness solely from elapsed time.

acceptance_checks.criterion: AC6: Record limitations, historical equivalence availability, acceptance status, and remaining gaps for planner assessment.
acceptance_checks.expected: The Result states whether equivalent historical before/after calculation results with matching inputs exist, does not infer calculation equivalence from timing or changed account data, and records outstanding or received user acceptance and the UD-013/UD-014 gaps.
acceptance_checks.verification: Review the final evidence record against the historical PERF-002 and QUALITY-005 findings; preserve unresolved acceptance and stale-refresh questions for planner assessment.

invariants: The measurement uses the real user PostgreSQL database and the complete requested result set.
Real account data, acquisition settings, ownership, limits, and calculations remain unmodified.
The user's browser profile/cache is not deleted or reused as disposable cold state.
End-to-end time includes all observed refresh wait and major pipeline stages; no stage is silently excluded.
A result is considered complete only after quiescence including row identity and a successful displayed-value read.
Elapsed-time measurements do not establish historical calculation equivalence without matching inputs and result evidence.
UD-013 acceptance and UD-014 stale-account budget scope remain unresolved by this measurement.
existing_tests_reviewed: frontend/scripts/profit-page-perf.mjs: existing real-browser harness for the three cache phases; measures default and complete-set openings, navigation-to-quiescent completion, row counts, displayed state, requests, and stage timings.
docs/TEST_STRATEGY.md §34: defines real-database complete-page measurement, quiescence, displayed-value read, full results, and evidence requirements.
STORY-PERF-002 Result: records the historical procedure and prior measurements; those measurements predate the current calculation/request paths.
STORY-QUALITY-005 Result §5 F1 and §7: establishes the current-revision evidence gap and states that no performance measurement was taken during that review.
test_specifications: From `frontend/`, run the existing harness once for each phase: `npm run perf:profit-page cold-browser-cold-app`, `npm run perf:profit-page cold-browser-warm-app`, and `npm run perf:profit-page warm-browser-warm-app`. Use a freshly built production frontend and the real configured PostgreSQL database; use the harness's disposable browser profile and isolated icon-store setup.

For each phase, retain individual first and repeat opening timings and the complete-set opening timing. Confirm the report identifies the measured revision, requested and displayed row counts, displayed-value readability, quiescence completion, and relevant request/stage attribution.

Across the three reports, state each phase maximum and overall maximum and explicitly assess every measured opening against 7000 ms. If setup/access prevents a run, record the exact blocker and do not substitute CI, synthetic data, or mocked checks.

Record account freshness evidence and any observed automatic refresh/wait alongside the run context. State historical-equivalence evidence availability and acceptance status without resolving UD-013 or UD-014.

pre_implementation_verification.command: Not run during QA preparation; the required real-database measurement belongs to story execution and requires the production frontend, live local services, and user database.

coverage_review: No coverage report was reviewed because this story changes no production code or verification tooling and explicitly sets no coverage target. QUALITY-005 reports prior scoped coverage evidence but it is not a current coverage measurement for this story. No percentages are inferred.
post_implementation_review_reason: The deliverable is the real-data measurement evidence itself. Review is needed to verify all three cache-state runs, complete-result and displayed-value checks, freshness reporting, maxima against the budget, and the explicitly retained historical-equivalence and acceptance gaps.

post_implementation_reviews.reason: The real-data measurements and completion checks are present, but the Result still misstates the recording proxy’s timing boundary, so its stage attribution does not meet AC4.
evidence: The three required phase logs show successful runs, complete-set counts of 3205/3205, and maxima of 3785 ms, 4128 ms, and 4069 ms; the supplementary stale-price run is separately reported as a 17206 ms breach.
The harness checks quiescence, row identity, displayed-value readability, and complete-set row counts. The QA plan’s lack of prepared test files is justified for this measurement-only story.

frontend/scripts/recordingProxy.mjs records elapsed time in the backend response callback before piping the response body to the client. The Result still describes the proxy interval as ending when the response is fully forwarded.
actionable_items: Revise the Result’s stage attribution to describe the proxy measurement as request receipt through response headers, and distinguish it from subsequent body transfer, parsing, and rendering. Preserve the navigation-to-completion measurements and budget findings; no production or harness change is needed.

post_implementation_reviews.reason: The measurement-only story’s acceptance criteria are supported by the recorded runs and harness checks. The prior proxy timing issue is corrected in the Result, and the reported timing boundary matches the recording proxy implementation. No CI result is required for this review.
evidence: The three required phase logs record five openings each, complete-set displays of 3205/3205 rows, and phase maxima of 3785 ms, 4128 ms, and 4069 ms; all are within 7000 ms.
The supplementary stale-price run records a 17206 ms first-opening breach, distinguishing it from the required fresh-account cache-state measurements.

The harness checks quiescence, row identity, a displayed-value read, and complete-set row counts. No prepared test files are justified for a measurement-only story with an existing end-to-end harness.

The Result correctly states that proxy timing ends when response headers arrive, with body transfer, parsing, and rendering occurring afterward; this matches the proxy’s header write before piping the response body.
The Result preserves the historical-equivalence limitation and leaves UD-013 acceptance and UD-014 stale-account budget scope unresolved.
